info.name: WeKan
info.summary: Open source kanban boards with persistent SQLite storage
info.description: WeKan boards, cards, swimlanes and attachments, with Nextcloud sign-in. Requires AppAPI and a HaRP deploy daemon. Stores WeKan data and FerretDB SQLite in the app's persistent volume.
info.author: Lauri Ojansivu

variable.name: WEKAN_PUBLIC_URL
variable.description: Optional public HaRP URL ending in /exapps/wekan/. Set this when the deploy daemon's NEXTCLOUD_URL is an internal address. Otherwise it is derived from NEXTCLOUD_URL.

variable.name: NEXTCLOUD_ADMIN_USERS
variable.description: JSON array of exact Nextcloud user IDs, for example ["admin"]. Other users receive ordinary WeKan accounts; the first user is not automatically an administrator.
